Wave 2 closes the S101-deferred audit-integrity queue: the two cross-axis Stage-2 verifies that S101 W6 registered as STAGE-1-CANDIDATEs and explicitly deferred to S102 (§VII.BP H-Parity Drive-Exclusion, §VII.BQ Route-D 4-of-64 surviving-block lemma), the s=7 Pillar-VII LC genesis pole-tower bridge registration that S101 W1-2 discharged the prerequisite for, the §VII.AM Level-2/Level-3 envelope-row comparator reconciliation surfaced by the S101 W1-4 FAIL-high, and the second of the two S101-routed capstone designated-writer patches (§7.3 BF-spine reference-class dual-column). The carry-forward sources are the S101 W6 WP (items 6/7), the S101 W1 WP `## Carry-Forward Computations` block (items 8/9), and the S101 housekeeping §B Q2 ledger entry `B-CAPSTONE-§7.3-BF-SPINE-REFCLASS-S102` (item 10). This wave produces no new substrate-physics derivation: items 6/7 verify already-registered theorems from first principles under the joint-theorem 4-stage pathway; item 8 lands a verbatim-anchored bridge entry; item 9 adjudicates a pre-registered comparator over an already-computed envelope; item 10 is a reviewed prose patch reconciling capstone confidence to an already-landed register tier.

```yaml
# ---- Identity (6 fields) ----
gate_id: "CF-S102-HPARITY-STAGE2"
schema_version: "R3"

    TWO cross-reviewers dispatched in PARALLEL, one per axis, BOTH operating WITHOUT prior workshop
    context (read ONLY the registered §VII.BP Stage-1 entry text at registry line 21192 + the BINDING
    AMENDMENT BLOCK at line 21214; they do NOT receive the s100a-w1-hparity-scope-workshop.md transcript).
    Axis-A (spectral/NCG-axiomatic) audits the volovik-side equilibrium-thermodynamics clauses (a)-(c) +
    Regime annex (alpha)/(beta)/(gamma) + the JOINT clauses (e.1)/(e.2)/(f). Axis-B (transit-dynamics/
    cosmological-bridge) audits the transit-side relic clause (d) AT THE AMENDMENT-BLOCK coincidence-bounded
    grade (NOT the frozen E2 argument-grade span) + the JOINT clauses. JOINT clauses (e)/(f) are PASS-AND'd
    across both verdicts (logical AND). The producing script is a verdict-emission harness that ingests both
    reviewer clause-verdict JSONs, applies the PASS-AND aggregation per clause, and emits the composite Stage-2
    verdict; the substantive verification is the two agents' first-principles clause audits.
  producing_script: "computations/_shared/s102_w2_hparity_stage2_passand.py"

# ---- PRDR Checklist (8 items) ----

# (1) operator — the mathematical comparison form
operator:
  type: "set"
  form: >
    Stage2_PASS  iff  (for-all single-axis clause c in AxisA-clauses: verdict_AxisA(c) == PASS)
                 AND  (for-all single-axis clause c in AxisB-clauses: verdict_AxisB(c) == PASS)
                 AND  (for-all JOINT clause j in {(e.1),(e.2),(f)}: verdict_AxisA(j) == PASS AND verdict_AxisB(j) == PASS)
    where the relic clause (d) is graded against the AMENDMENT BLOCK (coincidence-bounded), NOT the frozen E2 argument-grade span.

# (2) strict_PASS_boundary — exact threshold value + direction
strict_PASS_boundary:
  value: "all clauses PASS in both axis verdicts; JOINT clauses PASS-AND = True; zero clause FAIL/INFO"
  direction: "="

# (3) boundary_reachable_analytically — is the threshold analytically derived?
boundary_reachable_analytically:
  bool: false
  proof_ref: "N/A — set-membership PASS-AND aggregation over two independent first-principles clause-audit verdicts; not a numerical-threshold gate (S95 non-COMPUTE gate note)"

# (4) reachable_rationals — does the admissible region contain a rational mesh?
reachable_rationals:
  includes_integer_mesh: false
  mesh_density: "N/A — discrete clause-verdict set (PASS/FAIL/INFO per clause)"

# (5) machinery_pin_map — every free parameter of producing_script, pinned
machinery_pin_map:
  N_eval: "N/A — verdict-aggregation harness, no eigenvalue/sample count"
  L_max: "N/A — Stage-2 verifies the registered Stage-1 entry text, not a fresh spectral compute"
  scan_range: "N/A"
  step_size: "N/A"
  tolerance: "N/A — clause verdicts are categorical (PASS/FAIL/INFO), no numerical tolerance"
  scheme: "JOINT-CROSS-AXIS-STAGE-2-PASS-AND"
  convention: "joint-theorem-promotion.md Stage-2; clause-(d)-grade=AMENDMENT-BLOCK-COINCIDENCE-BOUNDED"
  random_seed: "N/A — deterministic aggregation"
  GPU_path: "cpu-cap-OMP8 (no linear algebra; JSON ingest + boolean aggregation)"
  # CONDITIONAL pins:
  reviewer_assignment: >
    Axis-A (spectral/NCG-axiomatic) PRIMARY = lizzi-spectral-functional-theorist; pinned-fallback = connes-ncg-theorist.
    Axis-B (transit-dynamics/cosmological-bridge) PRIMARY = gen-physicist; pinned-fallback = kitaev-quantum-chaos-theorist.
    EXCLUSIONS (HARD): volovik-superfluid-universe-theorist AND transit-dynamics-theorist are the Stage-0 authors of
    the frozen E1+E2 candidate (registry line 21192) — BOTH Stage-2-EXCLUDED INCLUDING downstream-inheritance successors

    {lizzi, connes} x {gen, kitaev} — the cross-product is the admissible reviewer space after exclusion.
    Plan-freeze MUST run `_joint_theorem_independent_verify_audit.py --check-reviewers --strict`; a flagged
    primary fires its pinned-fallback (S101 A12 precedent: volovik->landau substitution fired as designed).
  reviewer_axis_distinctness: "Axis-A = spectral-functional/NCG-axiomatic; Axis-B = transit-dynamics/cosmological-bridge — DISTINCT axes per condition 1; neither reviewer shares the other's axis."
  substrate_input_orthogonality: >
    The two cross-reviewers read DISJOINT primary input artifacts where possible: Axis-A reads the §VII.BP frozen
    equilibrium-stratum clause text (clauses (a)-(c)+Regime annex, the Gibbs-Duhem / q_eq(H) thermodynamic content);
    Axis-B reads the AMENDMENT BLOCK + the W4-2 oddfloor npz `s101_w4_qeq_relic_oddfloor.npz` (the relic-resonance
    coincidence-bound data). The JOINT clauses (e)/(f) are the shared-read overlap by construction (PASS-AND target).
    Predicate per `joint-theorem-promotion.md §"Substrate-input-orthogonality clause"`: exists a clause whose data
    file is loaded by exactly ONE reviewer (the W4-2 npz, Axis-B only) -> structural-ceiling SATISFIED on clause (d);
    the JOINT-clause overlap carries the explicit "substrate-input-overlap caveat" on (e)/(f) per the SUGGESTION-status rule.

# (6) audit_discriminators — which inputs feed audit_sha256 vs content_sha256
audit_discriminators:
  audit_sha256_inputs: ["script", "axisA_clause_verdict_json", "axisB_clause_verdict_json", "registry_VIIBP_entry_text", "amendment_block_text", "pinmap"]
  content_sha256_inputs: ["script"]

# (7) substitution_chain — mandatory for sign/direction/threshold claims
substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Claim: "JOINT clauses (e)/(f) are graded by logical AND (PASS-AND), NOT logical OR, across the two axis verdicts;
            relic clause (d) is graded against the AMENDMENT BLOCK (coincidence-bounded), NOT the frozen E2 span."
    Definition 1: PASS-AND(j) := verdict_AxisA(j) == PASS  AND  verdict_AxisB(j) == PASS
                  [joint-theorem-promotion.md §"Stage 2": "JOINT clauses PASS-AND'd across the two verdicts
                   (both cross-reviewers must independently PASS each joint clause)"]
    Definition 2: grade_of_record(d) := AMENDMENT-BLOCK-coincidence-bounded
                  [registry line 21214 BINDING AMENDMENT: "this amendment block is the authoritative grade for
                   downstream consumers and for Stage-2"; the frozen clause-(d) text at line 21198+ is transcribed
                   UNALTERED but is NOT the grade-of-record — the demotion is an explicit override]
    Substitute: Stage2_PASS = [AND over single-axis clauses] AND [AND over JOINT clauses using PASS-AND(j)]
                with clause (d) evaluated under grade_of_record(d) = coincidence-bounded (NOT argument-grade).
    Simplify (logical):
      = (AxisA single-axis clauses all PASS)
        AND (AxisB single-axis clauses all PASS, with (d) audited at coincidence-bounded grade)
        AND (verdict_AxisA(e.1) AND verdict_AxisB(e.1))
        AND (verdict_AxisA(e.2) AND verdict_AxisB(e.2))
        AND (verdict_AxisA(f)   AND verdict_AxisB(f))
    Canonical form: Stage2_PASS is a conjunction (AND) over ALL clauses; a single FAIL on ANY clause in EITHER axis
                    forces Stage2 != PASS (blocks STAGE-1 -> STAGE-3 promotion).
    Direction: PASS-AND (conjunction) is STRICTLY STRONGER than PASS-OR (disjunction): a clause passing in one axis
               but failing in the other is NOT promoted under AND, whereas OR would promote it. The plan pins AND.
    Conclusion: Stage-2 promotion requires every clause to PASS in both axis verdicts; clause (d) is held to the
                coincidence-bounded grade (the W4-2 FAIL-demoted standard), NOT the original argument-grade span.

# (8) input_files — every file the producing_script reads, with SHA pin
input_files:
  canonical_constants:
    path: "computations/_shared/canonical_constants.py"
    sha256: "<computed-at-runtime>"   # may be modified by Wave-1 in-session promotions before this wave
  registry_VIIBP_entry:

# ---- Conditional blocks ----

    path: "computations/session-102/s102_w2_hparity_stage2_passand.py"
    artifact_kind: "script"
    must_contain:
      - "from canonical_constants import"

  data:

  plot:

  verdict_line:

    artifact_kind: "verdict_line"
    must_contain: "^CF-S102-HPARITY-STAGE2:.* audit_sha256=[a-f0-9]{64}"
    companion_row_required: true
    schema_v2_3tuple_required: false
  wp_section:
    path: "sessions/session-102/session-102-w2-workingpaper.md"
    artifact_kind: "wp_section"
    section_anchor: "### §W2-1. CF-S102-HPARITY-STAGE2"
    must_contain:
      - "\\*\\*Status\\*\\*:.*COMPLETED"
      - "\\*\\*Verdict\\*\\*:.*(PASS|FAIL|INFO)"
      - "\\*\\*Output Artifacts\\*\\*"
      - "\\*\\*MCP Pre-Compute Audit\\*\\*"

# ---- Verdict rubric ----
PASS_meaning: >
  Both cross-reviewers independently PASS all their single-axis clauses AND the JOINT clauses (e)/(f) PASS-AND across
  both verdicts, with relic clause (d) audited at the coincidence-bounded grade. §VII.BP promotes STAGE-1-CANDIDATE ->
  STAGE-3-PERMANENT (orchestrator-direct tag flip). The H-Parity Drive-Exclusion wall is structurally confirmed by
  independent cross-axis review without shared workshop context.
FAIL_meaning: >
  Either cross-reviewer FAILs ANY clause (single-axis or JOINT). Promotion is BLOCKED; §VII.BP stays STAGE-1-CANDIDATE;
  the FAILing clause routes to next-session remediation per the 4-stage pathway. Maps the boundary that the registered
  candidate's clause structure does NOT survive independent verification — a real constraint-map result, not an agent failure.
INFO_meaning: >
  Either reviewer returns INFO on a clause (e.g. coincidence-bounded clause (d) is judged genuinely ambiguous at
  independent review). §VII.BP stays STAGE-1-CANDIDATE; the INFO clause is documented as a Stage-2-INFO-deferred item.
  Also INFO if the reviewer-exclusion audit cannot seat two admissible distinct-axis reviewers (PRU Class-8 reviewer-pool gap).

# ---- Effort + framing ----
effort:
  files_created:
    - "computations/_shared/s102_w2_hparity_stage2_passand.py"
    - "computations/session-102/s102_w2_hparity_stage2_passand.npz"
    - "computations/session-102/s102_w2_hparity_axisA_verdicts.json"
    - "computations/session-102/s102_w2_hparity_axisB_verdicts.json"
    - "sessions/session-102/session-102-w2-workingpaper.md (§W2-1 section)"
  estimated_time: "1 wave (two parallel cross-reviewer dispatches + one aggregation harness)"

substrate_framing: |
  PHONONIC. The H-Parity Drive-Exclusion wall scopes what the substrate's OWN equilibrium thermodynamics can DRIVE at
  the tau_fold slice of the Jensen flow (tau_fold = 0.190): the q-channel backbone Gibbs-Duhem structure forbids a
  parity-asymmetric drive on the equilibrium stratum (clauses (a)-(c)). The relic sector (clause (d)) is the transit
  non-equilibrium half — frozen occupations {n_k, sigma_k} from Parker pair production at the diabatic fold transit
  (R_therm = 5251.82) — and the W4-2 odd-floor FAIL showed the narrow-band post-fold-tail resonance is IN-band live on
  14 occupied modes, so the relic exclusion is coincidence-bounded (the explanation flows D_K(tau) eigenvalue
```

```yaml
  value: "Level3_reconciled < Level2_reconciled(L_max=10) under the PRE-REGISTERED comparator candidate (decision frozen in this block before compute)"
  direction: "<"

boundary_reachable_analytically:

    in closed form from the pinned (alpha=4.6905, intercept) fit; the Level-3 reconciled quantity is either 3.0e-4 =
    (1 - Gamma_effacement) or the reorganization-rate residual. proof_ref =

  step_size: "N/A"
  tolerance: "strict inequality Level3 < Level2 (no tolerance band; the Registry-PASS criterion is a strict <)"
  scheme: "cross-pillar-bridge-anatomy.md Registry-PASS criterion; Level-3 annotation discipline (central-value, NOT band-containment)"
  convention: "envelope comparator PRE-REGISTERED = <DECISION below>; alpha=4.6905 (pinned W1-4)"
  random_seed: "N/A — deterministic"
  GPU_path: "cpu-cap-OMP8 (closed-form envelope evaluation; no linear algebra)"

  PRE_REGISTERED_comparator_decision: >
    DECISION (frozen at plan-freeze, BEFORE compute, per the substitution chain): the Level-2 envelope is the
    PREFACTORED form (ii) C·L^{-alpha} with C = exp(fit intercept), because the Level-2 envelope is DEFINED as the
    convergence-rate BOUND on ‖HKR(c_L) - c_continuum‖ (cross-pillar-bridge-anatomy.md Level-2 binding sub-class), and a
    convergence-rate bound carries its fitted amplitude — the bare L^{-alpha} drops the amplitude and is NOT the
    structural envelope. The Level-3 quantity is (Q3a) the bare deviation 3.0e-4 = (1 - Gamma_effacement) per the §VII.AM
    Level-3 anchor (Gamma_effacement = 0.9997 canonical; A(∂R)/(4 G_N A_universal) = 3.0e-4). This decision is fixed
    HERE; the compute only EVALUATES it — it does NOT search for the PASS-yielding choice.
  Level_3_annotation_discipline: >

    1-sigma-band / edge-containment statements are NON-LOAD-BEARING annotations and MUST NOT be read as PASS predicates.

audit_discriminators:
  audit_sha256_inputs: ["script", "viiam_alpha_envelope_pin_npz", "canonical_Gamma_effacement", "pinmap"]
  content_sha256_inputs: ["script"]

substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Claim: "The PREFACTORED comparator (ii) C·L^{-alpha} is the structurally-correct Level-2 envelope (NOT the bare
            L^{-alpha}); under (ii) with Level-3 = (Q3a) 3.0e-4, the reconciliation is independently motivated. The
            choice is made from the DEFINITION of Level-2, not from which yields PASS."
    Definition 1: Level-2 envelope := the algebraic convergence-rate BOUND on ‖HKR(c_L) - c_continuum‖, of the form
                  C·L^{-alpha} where alpha is the decay exponent and C the fitted amplitude (envelope = a BOUND, which
                  carries a multiplicative constant). [cross-pillar-bridge-anatomy.md §"Level 2" + Level-2 binding sub-class]
    Definition 2: alpha = 4.6905 (pinned W1-4, audit 251141bc); intercept = ln C (the fit intercept stored in the npz).
                  [s101_viiam_alpha_envelope_pin.npz: alpha, intercept]
    Definition 3: Level-3 anchor (Q3a) = 3.0e-4 = 1 - Gamma_effacement, Gamma_effacement = 0.9997 (canonical).
                  [§VII.AM Level-3: A(∂R)/(4 G_N A_universal) = 3.0e-4; get_constant Gamma_effacement = 0.9997]
    Definition 4: Registry-PASS := Level-3 < Level-2 at L_max=10 (central-value, strict <).
                  [cross-pillar-bridge-anatomy.md §"Registry-PASS criterion"]
    Substitute (candidate (i) BARE):     Level-2_bare(10)        = 10^{-4.6905}            = env_bare
                (candidate (ii) PREFACTORED): Level-2_prefac(10)  = exp(intercept)·10^{-4.6905} = env_at_Lmax10 (npz field)
    Simplify (direction read-off — WHICH envelope is structural):
      A convergence-rate envelope is a BOUND ‖HKR(c_L) - c_continuum‖ <= C·L^{-alpha}; dropping C (bare) asserts the
      bound has unit amplitude, which is NOT what the fit produced. Therefore the structural Level-2 is (ii) PREFACTORED.
      The decision between (i) and (ii) is thus made from the DEFINITION (Level-2 is a fitted bound with amplitude C),
      INDEPENDENT of which yields PASS — this is the anti-comparator-shopping guarantee.
    Canonical form: PASS  <=>  3.0e-4  <  exp(intercept)·10^{-4.6905}   (Level-3 = Q3a, Level-2 = candidate (ii)).
    Direction: the SIGN of [Level-2_prefac(10) - Level-3] read off the pinned (intercept, alpha) values determines
      PASS/FAIL/INFO; if exp(intercept)·10^{-4.6905} > 3.0e-4 the reconciliation restores Registry-PASS; if the
      prefactored envelope still sits below 3.0e-4, the row is FAIL (the theorem-structure is untouched, STAGE-3-PERMANENT);
      if the (i)/(ii) choice cannot be adjudicated from the definition (e.g. intercept ambiguous in the npz), INFO -> workshop.
    Conclusion: the reconciliation decision (Level-2 = prefactored (ii), Level-3 = Q3a 3.0e-4) is PRE-REGISTERED from
      the structural definition of the convergence-rate envelope; the compute EVALUATES the inequality on the pinned
      values; PASS iff the inequality holds, with the motivation being the envelope-is-a-bound argument, NOT the outcome.

# ---- Verdict rubric ----
PASS_meaning: >
  Under the PRE-REGISTERED reconciliation (Level-2 = prefactored C·L^{-alpha}, Level-3 = bare deviation 3.0e-4), the
  inequality Level-3 < Level-2 holds at canonical L_max=10, AND the reconciliation is independently motivated (envelope-
  is-a-bound argument fixed before compute). The §VII.AM envelope ROW restores Registry-PASS; the theorem-STRUCTURE is
  unaffected (was and remains STAGE-3-PERMANENT). The W1-4 FAIL-high is resolved as a comparator-form artifact.
FAIL_meaning: >
  Even under the structurally-correct prefactored comparator, Level-3 >= Level-2 at true alpha=4.6905. The §VII.AM
  envelope ROW genuinely FAILs the Registry-PASS criterion at the pinned alpha; the theorem-STRUCTURE is untouched
  (STAGE-3-PERMANENT). Maps the boundary: the algebraic-convergence-envelope ROW does not sit inside its bound at L_max=10
  — a real constraint on the envelope row, not on the structural identity.
INFO_meaning: >
  The comparator choice (i)/(ii) x (Q3a)/(Q3b) is genuinely ambiguous after the substitution-chain analysis (e.g. the
  npz intercept is degenerate, or the Level-3-quantity identity is contested). Route to a 2-agent workshop (Q1
  math/physics adjudication per Investigating-Workshops.md). NO comparator-shopping: the INFO is honest ambiguity, not
  a license to pick the PASS-yielding form.

  GEOMETRIC. The §VII.AM Universal Lock Condition's Level-2 envelope is a substrate-IS algebraic-convergence bound:
  delta_Gamma_eff/Gamma_eff ~ C·L^{-alpha} describes how fast the finite-L truncation's effacement deviation converges
  to the continuum HKR-image. The substrate IS this convergence rate; the Level-3 anchor (1 - Gamma_effacement = 3.0e-4,
  the canonical Volovik-partition fold-effacement) is the substrate's numerical effacement deviation at the canonical
  truncation. The reconciliation asks WHICH form of the envelope (bare vs amplitude-carrying) is the structural bound;
  the answer flows from the DEFINITION of a convergence-rate envelope (a bound ‖HKR(c_L) - c_continuum‖ <= C·L^{-alpha}
  carries its amplitude C), NOT from observation-fitting. This is a pure envelope-ROW reconciliation: the substrate's
  spectral-action effacement structure (the theorem) is fixed STAGE-3-PERMANENT; only the algebraic-envelope row's
  PASS/FAIL re-evaluates. The arrow D_K eigenvalues -> spectral-action effacement moment -> convergence envelope ->
  Registry-PASS row is unchanged.
```
